description: Add a ticket type to an event. Paid: set cost like "USD,2500" and capacity. Free: free=true and capacity. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

capacity.description: How many of this ticket can be sold. Required for normal (non-donation, non-tiered) tickets.

cost.description: Ticket price as "<CURRENCY>,<minor units>", e.g. "USD,1000" is $10.00. Must match the event currency. Only for paid tickets.

donation.description: True for a donation ticket (buyer picks the amount).

free.description: True for a free ticket (then omit cost).

hidden.description: Hide this ticket from the event page.

include_fee.description: Absorb the Eventbrite fee into the displayed price.

inventory_tier_id.description: Inventory tier to attach the ticket to (required for tiered events).

order_confirmation_message.description: Message shown on the order confirmation for this ticket.

sales_channels.description: Where it is sold: ["online"], ["atd"] (at the door) or both.

sales_end.description: When sales close, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

sales_start.description: When sales open, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

name: eventbrite_create_ticket_class
title: Create a ticket class
